text: Event consisting of the action of opening the doors of my bedroom for a whole weekend, where I present a spatial and emotional universe that only the few who are invited will be able to access: my best friends. The bedroom, equipped with an internet connection, is where all these practices live freely.
A materialisation and proposal that emerges from the theoretical research 'You're invited to my room', exploring fan practices and the phenomenon of fanfiction.
As part of the research on fanfiction.
